notes.title: Journey of Harvest Demo V1.2 Update
notes.notes:
-Modify and simplify the plot, add ESC to skip or left click to end dialogue quickly.
-Added tutorials for automated planting, watering, selling, and special props manufacturing and use.
-Added ‘Automation Setup’ mode for surface bases, which allows you to quickly deploy or dismantle conveyor belts, robotic arms, and related equipment.
-Added base construction mode, allowing you to build functional rooms in both surface and underground bases.
-In the adventure gathering mode, added the ‘equipment management’ function, which allows you to quickly configure adventure equipment before the start of each turn through the control interface.
Modified the deployment and drag-and-drop movement of adventure equipment in Adventure Gathering Mode.
-In Adventure Gathering Mode, when combining turrets, the bullet function will be combined, the attack power will be stacked, the range and cooldown time will be averaged, and the life value will be restored.
-In Adventure Gathering Mode, several basic turret values are adjusted.
-Added Black Stone Mining Cave living area map.
-Added Black Stone Mining Cave Adventure Guild, and added the function of hiring adventurers to explore.
-Modified some UI styles.
-Increased the turret upgrading function of the ‘Technology Research Centre’.
-Added the special chip manufacturing function of ‘Engineering Research Room’.
-Add 5 more manufacturable goods.

notes.title: Journey of Harvest Demo V1.08 Update
notes.notes:
-In Adventure Mode, the single turret upgrade has been changed to: any combination of turret upgrades.
-In Adventure Mode, the initial turret types have been changed to: 11 types.
-In Adventure Mode, the interactive function of ‘Adventure Console’ has been removed and changed to: configure in the mission settings before the lift departure.
-In Adventure Mode, the random reward at the end of the round has been changed to: Reward at the beginning of the round.
-In Adventure Mode, ‘Enemy Number’ and ‘Difficulty Factor’ have been added. Enemy Number indicates the number of attacking enemies per turn, while Difficulty Factor indicates the enemy boost per turn (Initial Life = Base Life x Difficulty Factor).
-Selecting different rewards will affect these two parameters.
-Selecting different items in the backpack bar will indicate the item name in the lower left corner.
-In Adventure Mode, right-click aiming increases the position of aiming point.
-In Adventure Mode, the movement effect will be increased when moving the device.
-In Adventure Mode, add quick action buttons.
-Fix the bug that when clicking the ‘Continue Game’ button for the second time, it can't be loaded.
-Fix the bug that some texts in ui tips are not displayed completely due to different resolutions.
